title: Yorkshire Pudding Jamie
method: Whisk the eggs, flour, salt, and milk together really well in a bowl to make your batter.
Pour the batter into a jug, and let it sit for 30 minutes before you use it.
Turn your oven up to the highest setting, and place a 12 tart tray in the oven to heat up for 5 minutes.
Place 1 tb of oil (lard is better) in each muffin hole, and put the tray back into the oven and heat until oil is very hot.
Open oven door, slide the tray half out, and carefully pour the batter into the tray's holes.
Close the door and cook for 15 minutes without opening the oven door.
